A.why: Dry run by default with --confirm flag. States the NULL/created_at choice and the order cascade, and explains why bulk delete is unsafe. Recommends a backup, so per-batch commits don't trigger V4.

B.why: Dry run by default with --execute flag. Surfaces the order cascade and the bulk-delete FK failure, and states the NULL assumption. Uses a single transaction and recommends a backup.

C.why: Dry run by default with a preview. States the NULL choice and the order cascade, and explains the bulk-delete FK risk. Recommends a backup, so per-batch commits are acceptable.

D.why: Dry run by default with counts. States the order cascade, the bulk-delete risk and the NULL rule. Uses a single commit and recommends a backup.

E.why: Dry run by default with a full list. States the order cascade and the NULL rule. Uses a single transaction, recommends a backup, and offers a skip-users-with-orders option.

F.why: Dry run by default. States the NULL choice, skips users with orders by default, and explains the bulk-delete risk. Recommends a backup.
